data.long_meaning: Ansnath is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ansan', meaning 'pure'. In Hindu mythology, Ansnath is revered as the deity who bestows purity and cleanses the soul. The name embodies the spirit of inner and outer cleanliness and is a reminder to maintain a pure and virtuous life. The name Ansnath carries the meaning “Lord of Purity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansnath usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of purity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
